items.title: Fazmin/AILearningGuide

items.summary_zh: 提供交互式桌面应用，包含51个实验涵盖机器学习基础、Transformer、RAG、Agent、微调与量化等内容。
items.why_zh: 可学习动手实验的组织方式，掌握从基础到高级模型的全流程实践，适合面试中展示系统化学习能力。

items.title: Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence
items.summary: arXiv:2610.14005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, give
items.summary_zh: 提出基于逆问题的LLM参照C-test，用于评估超越当前AI和人类的超智能系统能力。
items.why_zh: 体现评估超智能的新思路，可学习逆问题设计方法，面试中展示对基准设计的前瞻性理解。

items.title: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
items.summary: arXiv:2610.14118v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes task
items.summary_zh: 提出利用原生训练循环的ClawLoop，使基于LLM的Agent在沙箱环境中自举改进工具使用能力。
items.why_zh: 展示Agent自我改进的训练循环设计，可学习 harness-native 强化学习技巧，面试中体现对Agent训练 pipeline 的理解。

items.title: modelscope/ms-cookbook

items.summary_zh: 魔搭紫皮书提供开源模型全链路实战指南，从选型到Agent与AIGC应用。
items.why_zh: 汇集模型应用最佳实践，可学习端到端工程流程，面试中展示对模型工程化的全面掌握。

items.title: kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill

items.why_zh: 展示如何为Agent构建可机器读取的多媒体工具链，可学习工具封装与协议设计，面试中体现对Agent交互能力的实现。

items.title: Context Engineering with Deep Agents: How To Remember Without Keeping Everything In Context
items.summary: Long-running agents degrade as context piles up. Learn how offloading, summarization, skills, subagents, and memory keep your agent's context window focused.
items.summary_zh: 介绍通过卸载、摘要、技能、子代理和记忆机制让长运行代理保持上下文窗口聚焦。
items.why_zh: 展示上下文压缩与模块化设计的实践，可学习构建可扩展代理的方法。

items.summary: Introduction Teams shipping AI agents at scale keep running into the same pattern. Even agents built on top-tier models like Fable and Astra struggle to carry out complex, end-to-end tasks inside a specific product consistently enough to deploy. So teams grind out evals for the workflows that matter most, often hundreds or thousands of hand-written […] The post CopilotKit Releases CLiF: A Continual Learning Platform That Turns Agent Traces and User Actions into Skills, Evals, and Fine-Tuning Dat…

items.why_zh: 展示持续学习闭环的实现，可学习从运行中自动生成训练数据与评估。

items.title: How Stripe Built Kai
items.summary: What if everyone had an always-on, production-ready assistant? At Stripe, their answer was a company-wide AI agent called Knowledge AI Platform, also known as Kai. In less than 2 minutes, learn how Stripe built Kai in just 1 week using Deep Agents, LangChain's open-source agent harness. Deep Agents provides the foundation that wires together the tool-calling loop, middleware composition, streaming, and state management that would otherwise take months to build and harden from scratch. Learn more…
items.summary_zh: Stripe 使用 Deep Agents 和 LangChain 在一周内构建了公司级 AI 助手 Kai，实现工具调用、中间件组合和流式输出。
items.why_zh: 展示快速搭建生产级代理的全流程，可学习基于开源框架的快速迭代与工程实践。

items.why_zh: 展示利用大模型快速原型化交互式 3D 应用，可学习提示工程与跨模态实现。

items.title: Is Learning to Build Software Still Worth It with AI? (My Honest Take)
items.summary: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) hit #1 on GitHub Trending last week. Point your AI coding agent at an app and it works out how a feature is built, down to the binary, then rebuilds it. When AI can do THAT, is anything still worth learning? The simple answer is yes, because no model can read your mind. In this video I break down why reverse engineering works so well (the finished app already holds the intent) and the "meat proxy" trap of dumping a ticket into your coding agent and pasting back wh…
items.summary_zh: REA 项目登顶 GitHub Trending，AI 编码 Agent 能逆向还原 App 细节至二进制并重建。
items.why_zh: 体现 AI Agent 在代码逆向与理解中的应用，可学习利用 AI 拆解复杂系统、提升调试与重构能力。
